cleaner.label: Keras
cleaner.description: Datasets and model weights downloaded by Keras. Does not touch the keras.json configuration file.

option.label: Keras datasets
option.description: Removes the datasets downloaded to the datasets folder.
option.warning: Re-downloaded on next use (for example with `keras.datasets`).

option.label: Keras model weights
option.description: Removes the pretrained weights downloaded to the models folder.
option.warning: Re-downloaded the next time the pretrained models are used.
